offering_description.value: Provides financial data, analytics and investment workflow software to investment professionals and corporate finance teams. Delivered mainly as cloud-based subscriptions with custom data feeds and integration services for institutional clients.

primary_products.value: financial data feeds; portfolio analytics software; investment research tools; trading and order management software; data visualization tools

primary_services.value: custom data integration; consulting and implementation; training; managed data services

customer_segment.value: B2B: asset managers, hedge funds, banks, wealth managers, insurers, corporate finance teams

end_markets.value: financial services; asset management; investment banking; wealth management; corporate finance

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual or multi-year fees for data and software access; service fees: implementation, integration, consulting and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells analytics and workflow platforms to investment firms; service provider: aggregates and delivers financial data and integration services to institutional clients

geography_served.value: global: offices and clients across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: financial data, analytics software and workflow tools sharing the same investment professional clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to institutional clients; online: cloud-based web platforms and data feeds

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules and securities-related client obligations, plus exchange and data licensing terms
